name: Warriors Orochi 4 Ultimate: Deluxe Edition
storyline: After their earlier adventures across a merged dimensional world, the legendary heroes of ancient China's Three Kingdoms and Japan's Sengoku era have returned to their own times, their memories of those exploits erased. Their peace is shattered when Zeus, king of Olympus, pulls them back into the mystic realm for a purpose of his own. Scattered across the land are eight sacred bracelets, forged from the hair of Medusa and brimming with divine power, and as the heroes claim them they find themselves divided into rival factions, each channeling the might of gods drawn from Greek and Norse legend. Guided and manipulated by immortals with clashing agendas, warriors who once fought as enemies and allies alike are swept into a grand struggle where mortal ambition collides with the schemes of the gods. This complete edition weaves together the full saga alongside additional chapters that reveal hidden truths behind the conflict.
